form_variant.description: The form name printed at the top, e.g. 'SSA-1099' or 'SSA-1042S'

tax_year.description: The benefit year printed in large type at the top left, e.g. '2026'

beneficiary.description: The person the benefits were paid to, from boxes 1, 2 and 7

name.description: Box 1, the beneficiary's name, exactly as printed

ssn.description: Box 2, the beneficiary's Social Security number exactly as printed, including any masking such as XXXX

address.description: Box 7, the beneficiary's mailing address as one line

box_3_benefits_paid.description: Box 3, total benefits paid in the year, in dollars, as a number without $ or commas

box_4_benefits_repaid.description: Box 4, benefits repaid to SSA in the year, in dollars. Null if the box is blank

box_5_net_benefits.description: Box 5, net benefits for the year (box 3 minus box 4), in dollars

box_6_federal_tax_withheld.description: Box 6, voluntary federal income tax withholding, in dollars. Null if blank

box_8_claim_number.description: Box 8, the claim number. Null if the box is blank

box_3_description.description: The 'Description of amount in Box 3' panel, breaking down how box 3 was paid

paid_by_check_or_direct_deposit.description: Amount paid by check or direct deposit, in dollars

medicare_part_b_premiums.description: Medicare Part B premiums deducted from benefits, in dollars. Null if not listed

medicare_part_d_premiums.description: Medicare prescription drug (Part D) premiums deducted, in dollars. Null if not listed

total_additions.description: The 'Total additions' amount, in dollars. Null if no amount is printed beside the label

benefits_for_year.description: The 'Benefits for <year>' total at the bottom of the panel, in dollars

box_4_description.description: Any text or amounts in the 'Description of amount in Box 4' panel. Null if the panel is empty
